summary.intent: Execute the full `/ship-phase 66` autonomous post-execute pipeline for CipherBox Phase 66 (API schema cutover, IPNS publish gate, tombstone): verify → secure → validate → simplify → SDK E2E gate → CodeRabbit CLI → ship → resolve all PR reviews → confirm CI green.
summary.outcome: PR #584 opened and all 10 pipeline steps executed; 19 CodeRabbit inline threads resolved (15 fixed, 4 deferred), CodeRabbit review-body nitpick/outside-diff comments addressed in a final commit. Multiple CI failures were diagnosed and fixed (coverage thresholds from deleted specs, SDK E2E mock-routing phantom-file typo, throttle exhaustion). Session ended during the final commit of review-body fixes before verifying CI on that last commit.

repo: jest `coverageThreshold` subtracts path-specific threshold files from the global computation — EXIT=0 is authoritative even when the 'All files' summary row shows below the global percentage

The CI SDK E2E job has used `node dist/server.js` since PR #318, but mock-ipns-routing compiles to `dist/index.js` — the server has never run in CI; other tests passed only because they don't resolve via delegated routing

`BypassableThrottlerGuard` tracks per-IP by default; CI sets `THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET` only on the test step, not the API process, so the header bypass silently fails and the heavy e2e suite exhausts per-route @Throttle buckets
CodeRabbit posts findings in two separate places: resolvable inline threads AND a review body with 'Nitpick' and 'Outside diff range' sections — both must be addressed separately
Phase 66 deleted all 5 shares spec files during the cutover without rewriting them, leaving jest per-file thresholds at 0% and the global branches below 78%
`gh pr edit` fails on this repo (Projects-classic GraphQL) — patch the PR body via `gh api -X PATCH repos/FSM1/cipher-box/pulls/<N> -F body=@file`
After `gh pr create` and a passing Release Preview, github-actions[bot] pushes a `chore(release)` commit — must `git fetch` + rebase before the next push or it will be rejected

`api:generate`'s trailing repo-wide `eslint .` hits pre-existing generated files in `landing/.astro/*` (gitignored) and causes exit-1 — this does not affect CI Lint; check whether `openapi.json` changed semantically and revert if formatting-only
Commit helper frequently reports exit 143 (timeout on 1Password signing) while the commit actually lands — always verify with `git log --oneline -1`, never blindly retry

`.claude/settings.local.json` PostToolUse hooks were using relative paths (`.claude/hooks/...`) instead of `$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/hooks/...`, causing `cjs/loader:1433` errors whenever a Bash command `cd`-ed into a subdirectory

code.finding: T-66-E1 fix: write grant must be gated on `invite.writeDescriptorRef !== null`, not just whether claimer supplied `dto.writeDescriptorRef` — without this gate a read-only invite yields a write grant

seqFloor gate: rows with null `signedRecord` are 'typical of shared-folder rows inserted by the sharing protocol that never had a signedRecord written'; resolve must fail closed when network seq < floor and serve when seq >= floor

Delegated-routing publish is fire-and-forget (detached promise) — under heavy load in CI it can be rate-limited and dropped, making any test that depends on a network record being present inherently flaky

syncIpnsRecordSequence lacked a forward-only sequence guard: a stale TEE batch result could overwrite a row whose sequenceNumber was already advanced higher by a user publish — fix adds `LessThanOrEqual(newSequenceNumber)` to the update criteria

publishBatch error handler only re-threw ConflictException (409), letting tombstone-gate's HttpException(GONE/410) fall through to generic `{success:false}` — the 410 permanent-failure signal was lost, enabling retry loops to hammer a retired name

Added `if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test') { return true; }` short-circuit — disables all rate limiting in test env; CI API starts with NODE_ENV=test but THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET is not set on the API process so the header bypass silently failed
`encryptedKey` used loose `/^[0-9a-fA-F]+$/` regex (allows odd-length hex) while siblings `itemNameEncrypted` and `writeDescriptorRef` were already tightened to `/^(?:[0-9a-fA-F]{2})+$/`

Test 15 (seqFloor at-floor serve) directly seeded DB rows via psql to create null-signedRecord state unreachable through the publish API — this white-box coupling + fire-and-forget timing caused CI flakiness; moved to unit tests and removed

parseCachedRecord: a row with sequenceNumber but null signedRecord produces a SeqFloor discriminant; a row with a garbage signedRecord that fails parse returns null — both must fail closed at the resolve gate

workflow: Direct DB seeding in e2e tests is a smell when the state being seeded is unreachable through the public API — move to unit tests with mocks; keep e2e only for behaviors that genuinely need the live stack (concurrency, CAS round-trips, tombstone end-to-end)
When a CI background process fails (e.g., `node dist/server.js &`) but the step is masked by `&` + `sleep`, the job 'passes' silently — replace with a health-poll loop that fails loudly

Workflow tool fan-out (5 parallel agents) can restore a large batch of deleted specs efficiently; adversarially verify by running the full coverage suite centrally rather than trusting per-agent scoped results
greptile 'outside of diff range' findings appear as issue-comments, not resolvable threads — they need separate fetching and manual disposition
When a pre-commit hook runs `eslint .` repo-wide and a step calls `api:generate`, check whether `openapi.json` changed semantically (diff the output) before committing to avoid formatting churn
The `status` variable name is reserved in zsh — use a different variable name in polling scripts
GSD security auditor and CodeRabbit independently identified T-66-E1 (write-grant escalation) — independent corroboration from two tools is a strong signal that a finding is real

friction: SDK E2E CI failure required three separate diagnoses: (1) throttle exhaustion hypothesis, (2) deterministic-seed approach rejected by user, (3) actual root cause — phantom `dist/server.js` file in the workflow that had been broken since PR #318
CodeRabbit review-body comments (nitpick + outside-diff sections) are not resolvable threads and require separate GraphQL fetching and manual scripted replies
Commit helper timeouts (exit 143 via 1Password signing) happened repeatedly throughout the session, requiring `git log` verification every time
`api:generate` always exits non-zero due to pre-existing gitignored generated-file lint errors, making it hard to determine if the actual OpenAPI surface changed
The `status` variable name in a zsh polling script caused a background task to fail with exit code 1
zsh `$()` quoting issues caused the initial GraphQL thread-fetch script to emit malformed JSON, requiring a rewrite to a Python script
The Phase 66 cutover silently deleted all 5 shares spec files without updating coverage expectations, causing a CI gate failure only discovered after the PR was opened
Fire-and-forget delegated-routing publish + per-IP throttle interaction caused Test 15 to fail non-deterministically in CI, requiring multiple iterations to root-cause correctly
